docs.title: PalSupervisor Wiki 🎮🛡️
docs.text:
Enterprise Native Supervisor, Proactive Anti-Cheat & Event Engine for Palworld Dedicated Servers

Welcome to the official documentation wiki for PalSupervisor-DLL. PalSupervisor is engineered in high-performance C++20 as a drop-in native extension (version.dll) integrating directly with the Unreal Engine 5.1.1 runtime.

docs.title: Key Capabilities
docs.text:
• ⚡ Sub-Microsecond Memory Detours: Hooks directly into UObject::ProcessEvent and CDO functions with zero tick delay or TPS degradation.
  • 🛡️ Proactive Anti-Cheat Matrix: Real-time detection of speed manipulation, infinite stamina, illegal damage spikes, and spoofed network packets.
  • 💬 116+ Native In-Game Commands: Full moderation, inventory editing, instant teleportation, and player state manipulation.
  • 👑 Dynamic Boss & Raid Engine: Summon custom multi-tier boss encounters from JSON templates with minions, custom loot tables, and broadcast banners.
  • 🧹 Autonomous Server Janitor: Scheduled sweeps to demolish abandoned wild structures and purge ground item clutter.
  • 🌐 Embedded REST API: Built-in HTTP daemon on port 27020 for remote bot integration and web dashboard management.

docs.title: What Are Commands?
docs.text: Commands are special text-based instructions that allow server administrators to interact with PalServer in real time. Commands start with a / (customizable in config.json) followed by the command name and optional arguments.

docs.title: Who Can Use Commands?
docs.text:
Commands marked as Admin require the executing player to be listed in admin_steam_ids or authenticated via the REST API. Commands marked as All can be executed by any connected player.

Command Syntax Guide

/command_name <required_argument> [optional_argument={default}]

  • <required_argument> → Must be included when executing the command.
  • [optional_argument] → Optional parameter. If omitted, default server value is used.

docs.title: Moderation
docs.text:
/kick

Syntax: /kick <player> [reason] Description: Kick a player from the server. Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * <player> [Required] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000). * [reason] [Optional] — Text explanation for the kick/ban action.

Example: 

/kick Smooth "AFK in spawn"
/kick 76561198000000000

/ban

Syntax: /ban <player> [reason] Description: Permanently ban a player. Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * <player> [Required] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000). * [reason] [Optional] — Text explanation for the kick/ban action.

Example: 

/ban CheaterPlayer "Speedhacking detected"

/unban

Syntax: /unban <player/uid/ip> Description: Remove a ban on a player UID or IP address. Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * <player/uid/ip> [Required] — Parameter: player/uid/ip

Example: 

/unban 76561198000000000

/banlist

Syntax: /banlist Description: Display list of all banned players. Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * None

Example: 

/banlist

/whitelist

Syntax: /whitelist <on|off|add|remove|list> [player] Description: Manage server whitelist access control. Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * <on|off|add|remove|list> [Required] — State toggle ('on' or 'off'). * [player] [Optional] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000).

Example: 

/whitelist <on|off|add|remove|list> [player]

/warn

Syntax: /warn <player> <message> Description: Send a formal warning and record a violation. Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * <player> [Required] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000). * <message> [Required] — Message string to broadcast or send to player.

Example: 

/warn <player> <message>

/freeze

Syntax: /freeze <player> [seconds] Description: Disable player input. 0 = until /unfreeze. Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * <player> [Required] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000). * [seconds] [Optional] — Duration in seconds (0 = permanent / until manual unmute).

Example: 

/freeze <player> [seconds]

/unfreeze

Syntax: /unfreeze <player> Description: Re-enable input for a frozen player. Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * <player> [Required] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000).

Example: 

/unfreeze <player>

/mute

Syntax: /mute <player> [seconds] Description: Block a player from sending chat. 0 = permanent. Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * <player> [Required] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000). * [seconds] [Optional] — Duration in seconds (0 = permanent / until manual unmute).

Example: 

/mute <player> [seconds]

/unmute

Syntax: /unmute <player> Description: Restore chat for a muted player. Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * <player> [Required] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000).

Example: 

/unmute <player>

/kickall

Syntax: /kickall [reason] Description: Kick all non-admin players from the server. Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * [reason] [Optional] — Text explanation for the kick/ban action.

Example: 

/kickall [reason]

docs.text:
/godmode

/godmode Smooth off

Arguments: * [on|off|give] [Optional] — State toggle ('on' or 'off'). * [player] [Optional] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000).

Example:

Arguments: * [player] [Optional] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000).

/setmaxweight

Syntax: /setmaxweight [player] <weight> Description: Override maximum inventory carrying weight. Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * [player] [Optional] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000). * <weight> [Required] — Carrying weight capacity limit.

docs.title: Teleportation
docs.text:
/tp

Syntax: /tp <player> <x> <y> <z> or <player> <destplayer> Description: Teleport a player to coordinates or another player. Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * <player> [Required] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000). * <x> [Required] — World coordinate axis X (in Unreal Engine centimeters). * <y> [Required] — World coordinate axis Y (in Unreal Engine centimeters). * <z> [Required] — World coordinate axis Z (in Unreal Engine centimeters). * or [Required] — Parameter: or * <player> [Required] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000). * <destplayer> [Required] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000).

Example: 

/tp Smooth -291200 253700 -1990
/tp Smooth AdminPlayer

/tpme

Syntax: /tpme <player> Description: Teleport yourself to a player. Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * <player> [Required] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000).

Example: 

/tpme Smooth

/tp2me

Syntax: /tp2me <player> Description: Pull a player to your location. Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * <player> [Required] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000).

Example: 

/tp2me Smooth

/spectate

Syntax: /spectate <player> Description: Spectate a player in admin mode. Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * <player> [Required] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000).

Example: 

/spectate Smooth

/tp2treasure

Syntax: /tp2treasure [grade 1-5] Description: Teleport to the nearest unopened wilderness treasure chest (optionally of specific grade). Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * [grade 1-5] [Optional] — Level grade from 1 to 5.

Example: 

/tp2treasure
/tp2treasure 5

/tp2deathbag

Syntax: /tp2deathbag <player> Description: Teleport directly to a player's lost death drop bag. Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * <player> [Required] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000).

Example: 

/tp2deathbag Smooth

docs.title: Inventory & Items
docs.text:
/giveitem (aliases: /givei)

Syntax: /giveitem <player> <itemid> [amount] Description: Give items to a player. Aliases: /givei Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * <player> [Required] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000). * <itemid> [Required] — Item static ID (e.g. PalSphere, Wood, Diamond). * [amount] [Optional] — Quantity count (e.g. 1, 50, 1000).

Example: 

/giveitem Smooth PalSphere 50
/giveitem Smooth AncientTechnologyPoint 5

/rewardi (aliases: /rewarditem, /itemreward)

Syntax: /rewardi [player|all] <item_name_or_id> [amount] Description: Reward items to inventory with native animated reward cards and HUD log. Aliases: /rewarditem, /itemreward Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * [player|all] [Optional] — Parameter: player|all * <item_name_or_id> [Required] — Item static ID (e.g. PalSphere, Wood, Diamond). * [amount] [Optional] — Quantity count (e.g. 1, 50, 1000).

Example: 

/rewardi all PalSphere 25
/rewardi Smooth Diamond 5

/repair

Syntax: /repair <player> Description: Restore full durability to all equipped weapons, armor, and gliders. Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * <player> [Required] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000).

Example: 

/repair Smooth

/inspectinv

Syntax: /inspectinv <player> Description: Inspect a player's common inventory items, quantities, and durability. Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * <player> [Required] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000).

Example: 

/inspectinv Smooth

/clearinv

Syntax: /clearinv <player> Description: Clear all items from a player's common inventory. Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * <player> [Required] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000).

Example: 

/clearinv Smooth

/takeitem (aliases: /removeitem)

Syntax: /takeitem [player] <item_id> [amount] Description: Remove a specified item and quantity (or all) from a player's inventory. Aliases: /removeitem Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * [player] [Optional] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000). * <item_id> [Required] — Parameter: item_id * [amount] [Optional] — Quantity count (e.g. 1, 50, 1000).

Example: 

/takeitem Smooth Wood 100
/takeitem Smooth Diamond

docs.title: Pals & NPCs
docs.text:
/rewardp (aliases: /rewardpal, /palreward)

Syntax: /rewardp [player|all] <pal_name_or_id> [level] [rank] Description: Reward a Pal to Party/PalBox with native capture visuals. Aliases: /rewardpal, /palreward Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * [player|all] [Optional] — Parameter: player|all * <pal_name_or_id> [Required] — Parameter: pal_name_or_id * [level] [Optional] — Level from 1 to 60+. * [rank] [Optional] — Condensation star rank (0 to 4).

Example: 

/rewardp all JetDragon 50 4
/rewardp Smooth Anubis 40 2

/revivepals

Syntax: /revivepals <player> Description: Revive and fully restore HP, hunger, and sanity of all party Pals. Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * <player> [Required] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000).

Example: 

/revivepals Smooth

/wipepals

Syntax: /wipepals <player> Description: Clear all Pals from a player's active party. Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * <player> [Required] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000).

Example: 

/wipepals Smooth

/givepal (aliases: /givep)

Syntax: /givepal [player] <PalID> [level] [rank] Description: Spawn and add a Pal directly to a player's party. Aliases: /givep Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * [player] [Optional] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000). * <PalID> [Required] — Internal Pal species ID (e.g. SheepBall, JetDragon, Anubis). * [level] [Optional] — Level from 1 to 60+. * [rank] [Optional] — Condensation star rank (0 to 4).

Example: 

/givepal Smooth JetDragon 50 4
/givepal SheepBall 1

/givenpc (aliases: /given)

Syntax: /givenpc [player] <NpcID> [level] Description: Add a human NPC directly to a player's party / PalBox. Aliases: /given Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * [player] [Optional] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000). * <NpcID> [Required] — Human NPC entity ID (e.g. Police_Rifle_Crime_Lv5). * [level] [Optional] — Level from 1 to 60+.

Example: 

/givenpc Smooth Police_Rifle_Crime_Lv5 50

/spawnp (aliases: /spawnpal)

Syntax: /spawnp [player] <PalID> [level] Description: Spawn a wild Pal in the world next to a player. Aliases: /spawnpal Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * [player] [Optional] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000). * <PalID> [Required] — Internal Pal species ID (e.g. SheepBall, JetDragon, Anubis). * [level] [Optional] — Level from 1 to 60+.

Example: 

/spawnp SheepBall 5
/spawnp Smooth JetDragon 50

/spawnw

Syntax: /spawnw <PalID> <level> <x> <y> <z> Description: Spawn a wild Pal in the world at specific coordinates. Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * <PalID> [Required] — Internal Pal species ID (e.g. SheepBall, JetDragon, Anubis). * <level> [Required] — Level from 1 to 60+. * <x> [Required] — World coordinate axis X (in Unreal Engine centimeters). * <y> [Required] — World coordinate axis Y (in Unreal Engine centimeters). * <z> [Required] — World coordinate axis Z (in Unreal Engine centimeters).

Example: 

/spawnw SheepBall 15 -291200 253700 -1990

/spawnnpcp (aliases: /spawnnpc)

Syntax: /spawnnpcp [player] <NpcID> [level] Description: Spawn an active human NPC in front of a player. Aliases: /spawnnpc Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * [player] [Optional] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000). * <NpcID> [Required] — Human NPC entity ID (e.g. Police_Rifle_Crime_Lv5). * [level] [Optional] — Level from 1 to 60+.

Example: 

/spawnnpcp Smooth Police_Rifle_Crime_Lv5 50

/spawnnpcw

Syntax: /spawnnpcw <NpcID> <level> <x> <y> <z> Description: Spawn an active human NPC at specific world coordinates. Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * <NpcID> [Required] — Human NPC entity ID (e.g. Police_Rifle_Crime_Lv5). * <level> [Required] — Level from 1 to 60+. * <x> [Required] — World coordinate axis X (in Unreal Engine centimeters). * <y> [Required] — World coordinate axis Y (in Unreal Engine centimeters). * <z> [Required] — World coordinate axis Z (in Unreal Engine centimeters).

Example: 

/spawnnpcw Police_Rifle_Crime_Lv5 50 -291200 253700 -1990

/takepal (aliases: /removepal)

Syntax: /takepal [player] <pal_id|slot_1-5> [count] Description: Remove a specified Pal species or specific party slot (1-5) from a player. Aliases: /removepal Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * [player] [Optional] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000). * <pal_id|slot_1-5> [Required] — Level grade from 1 to 5. * [count] [Optional] — Parameter: count

Example: 

/takepal Smooth 1
/takepal Smooth SheepBall 1

/palparty (aliases: /inspectpals)

Syntax: /palparty [player] Description: Inspect a player's active Pal party (slots, level, IVs, rank, passives). Aliases: /inspectpals Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * [player] [Optional] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000).

Example: 

/palparty Smooth

docs.title: Bosses & Raids

/listtemplates

/reloadtemplates

docs.title: Features & Architecture
docs.text: PalSupervisor operates as an in-process native supervisor and telemetry engine injected directly into PalServer-Win64-Shipping-Cmd.exe via Windows DLL proxy (version.dll).

docs.title: 1. Engine Detour Hooking & Zero Overhead
docs.text:
• Direct ProcessEvent Interception: Intercepts Unreal Engine RPCs and execution dispatches before game logic executes them, allowing instantaneous sanitization of malicious packets.
  • No Client Mods Required: Works with 100% standard, unmodded vanilla Palworld game clients.
  • Microsecond Latency: Pure native C++ execution with average detour overhead under 0.02ms.

docs.title: 2. Proactive Anti-Cheat Engine
docs.text:
• Movement Heuristics: Multi-tick velocity and delta-position validation detects speed hacks, noclip, illegal flight, and unauthorized teleportation.
  • Stat & Stamina Sanitization: Prevents infinite stamina exploits, out-of-bounds player HP, and impossible stat point distribution.
  • Dev & Debug RPC Interception: Blocks client invocation of developer functions (Debug_InvaderMarch, cheat RPCs) and enforces automatic bans.
  • RPC Flood Rate-Limiter: Throttles network spam and denial-of-service attempts against the server thread.
  • Violation Audit: Full telemetry recording accessible via /violations and GET /violations.

docs.title: 3. Deep Player Telemetry & Inspection (Online & Offline)
docs.text:
• Online & Offline Inspection: Scans memory containers and directly accesses player data even when users are disconnected using UPalGroupManager and save file GUIDs.
  • Party Pal Deep-Scan: Species, level, rank, HP, talent IVs (0-100), active/passive skills, and illegal stat detection.
  • Inventory & Durability: Real-time inspection of bag slots, weapons, armor, and equipment with live durability tracking.
  • Location Breadcrumbs: Logs recent 30-point coordinate history to inspect player pathing.

docs.title: 4. Live Pal Mutator & Player Stat Resetter
docs.text:
• Zero-Downtime Party Pal Mutator: In-memory editing of party Pals via UPalOtomoHolderComponentBase and FPalIndividualCharacterSaveParameter.
  • Instantly mutate Level (1-60), Rank (1-5), Gender, Nickname, Passives, and IVs (Talent_HP, Talent_Melee, Talent_Shot, Talent_Defense).
  • Triggers immediate network replication to clients via OnRep_SaveParameter without relogging.
  • Player Stat Resetter & Refund:
  • Scans GotStatusPointList, calculates all allocated points, refunds them directly into UnusedStatusPoint, and syncs via client network RPCs.

docs.title: 5. Guilds & Base Camp Administration
docs.text:
• Guild Roster Management: Comprehensive guild roster tracking, master assignment, kick, rename, and disbanding.
  • Base Camp Demolition: Remote base camp dismantling frees territory without server downtime.
  • Worker Palbox Telemetry: Inspects all Pals assigned to base work, including current HP, SAN, hunger, depression/fracture debuffs, and passives.
  • Chest Storage Auditor: Lists slot capacities, lock states, and inventory item counts across all base storage containers.
  • Automated Inactivity Pruning: Audits inactive guilds and bases, previewing or automatically dismantling abandoned bases (POST /api/guilds/cleanup).

docs.title: 6. World Loot & Map Entity Telemetry (1,600+ Objects)
docs.text:
• Live Entity Scanning: Iterates UPalMapObjectManager across the entire world map with exact $(X, Y, Z)$ coordinates.
  • Tracked Entities:
  • Wilderness treasure chests (Grades 1-5, unopened state, drop tables)
  • Player death bags and corpses with instant remote item recovery
  • Loose item drops on the ground
  • Unowned or wild player structures constructed outside base camp territories
  • Active supply capsules and incoming meteorites

docs.title: 7. World Bosses, Dungeons & Instant Respawner
docs.text:
• Complete Boss Enumeration: Scans 254 APalNPCSpawnerBase actors (FieldBosses, DungeonBosses, ImprisonmentBosses, TowerBosses).
  • Live Status Tracking: Coordinates, active/spawned state, respawn cooldowns, and class names.
  • Instant Boss Respawner: Resets spawner cooldowns and triggers SpawnRequest_ByOutside(true) on-demand.

docs.title: 8. Base Camp Raid & Incident Controller
docs.text:
• Active Raid Telemetry: Queries UPalInvaderManager for ongoing enemy raids, wave counts, and remaining timers.
  • Manual Raid Spawner: Force-triggers enemy raid marches against any player base camp.
  • Instant Raid Cancellation: Disperses and cancels active enemy raids immediately with server broadcast.

docs.title: 9. Dynamic Weather & World Environment
docs.text:
• SkyCreator Atmospheric Control: Direct integration with BP_PPSkyCreatorWeatherPresetController_C.
  • Preset Switching: Switch between Clear, Rain, Thunderstorm, Foggy, and custom twilight presets on-demand.
  • Time Dilation: Set the in-game clock hour (0-24) and time dilation speed (timescale).

docs.title: 10. Autonomous Background Server Janitor
docs.text:
• Wild Structure Demolition: Automatically sweeps and cleans unowned or orphaned structures constructed outside base camps to prevent physics engine lag.
  • Ground Drop Cleanup: Periodically clears abandoned ground item drops to preserve server memory and tick rate.
  • Configurable Sweep Intervals: Fully customizable intervals and manual on-demand triggers (POST /api/janitor/run).

docs.title: 11. Real-Time Server-Sent Events (SSE) Bus
docs.text:
• Persistent HTTP Stream: High-performance text/event-stream keeping dashboards and Discord bots updated in real-time without polling.
  • Broadcast Events: player_join, player_leave, chat_message, raid_start, raid_end, boss_spawn, janitor_sweep, weather_change, and anti-cheat violations.

docs.title: 12. Vanilla Client-Compatible Modal Popups & Visual HUD Rewards
docs.text:
• Native Modal Dialogs: Displays centered modal popup dialogs with formatted text, emojis, and [ OK ] buttons on unmodded vanilla clients.
  • Animated Item Rewards: Triggers the client-side acquisition card queue (WBP_PalIngameMenuItem_GetGroup_C) and HUD notification log.
  • PalDex Banners: Displays capture celebration banners when rewarding Pals to players.

docs.title: 13. Universal Command Dispatcher & Official v1 API Compatibility
docs.text:
• Universal Slash Command API: Execute any of the 116 in-game slash commands directly via POST /admin/command or POST /v1/api/command.
  • Drop-In PalServer v1 API: 100% compatible with official tooling (/v1/api/info, /v1/api/players, /v1/api/announce, /v1/api/kick, /v1/api/ban, /v1/api/unban, /v1/api/save, /v1/api/shutdown).

docs.title: 14. Live Reflection & Unreal Object Explorer
docs.text:
• Runtime Object Search: Query and inspect UObject instances directly in server memory.
  • Dynamic Property Inspection: View fields, addresses, and values in real time.
  • Remote UFunction Invocation: Safely call game functions dynamically without recompiling the server.

docs.title: 15. Embedded REST API & Web Panel
docs.text:
• Integrated HTTP Server: Native embedded server listening on port 8212 (configurable).
  • Multi-Scheme Authentication: Supports X-API-Key, JWT Bearer tokens, and HTTP Basic Auth.
  • Web Dashboard: Included responsive glassmorphic web portal for monitoring and management.

docs.title: Installation Guide
docs.text: PalSupervisor requires no external mod loaders, UE4SS, or complex dependencies.

docs.title: Step 1: Deploy version.dll
docs.text:
Copy version.dll directly next to the PalServer binary: 

PalServer\Pal\Binaries\Win64\version.dll

docs.title: Step 2: Configure config.json
docs.text:
Place your customized config.json in the same directory: 

PalServer\Pal\Binaries\Win64\config.json

Example configuration: 

{
  "version": "0.4.1",
  "chat": {
    "command_prefix": "/",
    "enable_chat_commands": true,
    "admin_steam_ids": [
      "76561198000000000"
    ]
  },
  "api": {
    "enabled": true,
    "port": 27020,
    "bind_address": "0.0.0.0"
  },
  "anticheat": {
    "speed_check": true,
    "stamina_check": true,
    "auto_ban_threshold": 5
  },
  "janitor": {
    "enabled": true,
    "sweep_interval_minutes": 30
  }
}

docs.title: Step 3: Launch Server
docs.text:
Start your dedicated server normally: 

PalServer-Win64-Shipping-Cmd.exe
PalSupervisor will initialize automatically upon server startup.

docs.title: Step 4: Verify
docs.text: Type /help in in-game chat or visit http://127.0.0.1:27020/health in your browser.

docs.title: REST API Reference
docs.text:
PalSupervisor embeds a high-performance native HTTP server directly into version.dll within PalServer-Win64-Shipping-Cmd.exe. It allows external web panels, companion bots, automated scripts, and management tools to inspect and control the dedicated server in real time.

  • Base URL: http://127.0.0.1:8212
  • Default Port: 8212 (Configurable in PalSupervisor.json via "rest_api_port")
  • Content-Type: application/json

docs.title: Authentication & Security
docs.text:
PalSupervisor supports three authentication schemes:

  1. X-API-Key Header (Recommended for external panels & bots): 
    X-API-Key: your_secure_admin_key
  2. Bearer JWT Token: Obtained via POST /auth/login: 
    Authorization: Bearer <token>
  3. HTTP Basic Auth: Standard HTTP basic auth header with username admin and configured password: 
    Authorization: Basic YWRtaW46ZGVmYXVsdF9pbnNlY3VyZV9hZG1pbl9rZXk=

Local Loopback Exemption

Requests originating from local loopback addresses (127.0.0.1, ::1, localhost) can be allowed automatically depending on your PalSupervisor.json security settings.

docs.title: 7. Progression, Inventory & Cheats

  • POST /admin/player/setlevel — {"player": "PalTrainer", "level": 55}
  • POST /admin/player/resetlevel — {"player": "PalTrainer", "level": 1}
  • POST /admin/player/giveexp — {"player": "PalTrainer", "exp": 50000}
  • POST /admin/player/setmaxweight — {"player": "PalTrainer", "weight": 5000}
  • POST /admin/player/rename — {"player": "OldName", "name": "NewName"}
  • POST /admin/player/unlockmap — {"player": "PalTrainer"} (clears fog of war)
  • POST /admin/player/unlockfasttravel — {"player": "PalTrainer"} (unlocks all statues)
  • POST /admin/player/unlockbarriers — {"player": "PalTrainer"} (clears sanctuary barriers)
  • POST /admin/player/completepaldex — {"player": "PalTrainer"} (100% Paldex unlock)
  • POST /admin/player/unlockalltech — {"player": "PalTrainer"} (unlocks all recipes)
  • POST /admin/player/setrelics — {"player": "PalTrainer", "relics": 10} (sets capture power)
  • POST /admin/player/clearwanted — {"player": "PalTrainer"} (clears PIDF bounty)
Inventory & Item Control
  • POST /admin/give/item — {"player": "PalTrainer", "item": "PalSphere_Legendary", "count": 100}
  • POST /admin/inventory/repair — {"player": "PalTrainer"} (repairs equipped items)
  • POST /admin/inventory/clear — {"player": "PalTrainer", "target": "all"} (all, bags, gear, or keys)
  • POST /admin/inventory/remove — {"player": "PalTrainer", "item": "PalSphere_Legendary", "count": 10}

10. World Bosses, Raids & Environment
docs.text:
GET /api/bosses & POST /api/bosses/respawn
  • GET /api/bosses: Returns all 254 field, dungeon, and tower boss spawners with live spawned state.
  • POST /api/bosses/respawn: {"boss": "all"} forces instant respawn of bosses by resetting cooldown timers.
GET /api/raids & POST /api/raids/trigger & POST /api/raids/cancel
  • GET /api/raids: Returns active base raid incidents and remaining timers.
  • POST /api/raids/trigger: {"player": "PalTrainer"} forces an enemy raid march against the target player's base.
  • POST /api/raids/cancel: {} stops and disperses any active base raid.
GET /api/world/environment & POST /api/world/weather & POST /api/world/time
  • GET /api/world/environment: Current and upcoming weather presets from BP_PPSkyCreatorWeatherPresetController_C.
  • POST /api/world/weather: {"preset": "Thunderstorm"} changes the active weather preset.
  • POST /api/world/time: {"hour": 12, "timescale": 1.0} adjusts server time and time flow speed.

13. Live Reflection & Unreal Object Explorer
docs.text:
Allows advanced server developers and panel maintainers to query and invoke Unreal Engine objects dynamically in memory without restarting the server.

GET /api/v1/explore/search

Query Parameter: ?query=PalCharacter Description: Search loaded UObject instances across memory.

GET /api/v1/explore/inspect

Query Parameter: ?address=0x18F4A2B0 Description: Inspect properties, fields, and values of a specific UObject.

POST /api/v1/explore/invoke

Request Body: {"address": "0x18F4A2B0", "function": "ResetStatus", "params": {}} Description: Dynamically invokes a UFunction on the target object via reflection.
